title: Update statuses, overdue and empty cells on the placed on the market submissions pages
why:
Jen updated the statuses and how overdue returns look.

**Statuses**

- To review, Under review, Query raised, Response received, Accepted and Escalated, in the table and the status filter (version B)
- New tag colours, because two of the old ones don't exist in GOV.UK Frontend 6, so To review and In progress looked the same. See the [GOV.UK tag component](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/tag/)
- No red status tags

**Overdue**

- "Overdue" in bold black text above the review by date, in both versions
- Not red: in GOV.UK services red text means an error. See the [GOV.UK error message component](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-message/)
- We tried a red tag in version A first, but bold black text looks better and is clear enough

**Empty cells**

- Once a return is accepted there's nothing to review, so the Review by cell is empty on screen. Screen readers hear "Not applicable", as the regulator toolkit does, instead of "blank"

**Kept as they are**

- Short months in the table ("Jul to Sep 2026"), in full in the filters. The [GOV.UK style guide](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/style-guide/a-to-z-of-gov-uk-style#dates) allows short months in tables when space is tight

**Next**

- Late submissions: we'll show these on the submission page as a flag, for example "Submitted 3 days late", not in this table

beforeAfter.label: Version B, desktop (1020 pixels wide), top of the page
